source.trigger: RC2 真实派工暴露的 F-CAP-1 / F-ACC-1；用户指令「F-CAP-1 / F-ACC-1 要进下一轮源码修复」

fixes.summary: An admission refusal that never reached the native boundary used to occupy the single workflow slot; cancel left it blocked and the slot stayed occupied.
changes: isClosed() accepts a third closure path: cancelled task plus task_closed event whose source_ref is never_dispatched:<attemptId>

neverDispatched(taskId, attemptId) requires the occupant to belong to the task, matching attempt, no effect_started/outcome_unknown operation, no effectStartedAt/dispatchEnteredAt, and no task_closed event
closeNeverDispatched(taskId, attemptId, reason) writes state=cancelled, clears blockingReason, appends task_closed (closure=never_dispatched) and deletes workflow_capacity in one transaction
requestCancellation uses that branch; finishCancellation returns closed:true, capacityReleased:true, remoteStopped:false, executionState=never_dispatched and states it is not native stop proof
CAPACITY_OCCUPIED now names the occupying task and points at continue/cancel
fixes.deliberatelyNotChanged: blocked is not auto-closed, because gateway/test/desktop-queue.test.ts relies on correcting a refused dispatch with continue

fixes.summary: The earlier diagnosis 'MCP has no checks() entry point' was wrong: workbuddy_check_task exists. The real blocker was a $scope failure whose note hid the unauthorized path.
changes: $scope note uses scope.error, else lists unauthorized changes (up to five), else keeps the original generic text
review() INVALID_REVIEW message points at workbuddy_check_task for the batch
check_task and review_task descriptions state where machineCheckIds come from
fixes.stillOpen: F-CONTRACT-1 (task body allowing a new file while allowedChanges is empty) is unchanged; only the reason is now visible

regressions: gateway/test/desktop-queue.test.ts: a cancellation before native dispatch closes the workflow and frees shared capacity
gateway/test/task-reviews.test.ts: T5 machine checks name the unauthorized workspace change instead of a generic scope note

runtimeProbe.target: unpacked RC3 candidate dist, synthetic task database, synthetic native session table
runtimeProbe.verdict: F-CAP-1 closure releases capacity on RC3
